title: REQ-01: Activation on onStartupFinished and QEMU: Connect available in Command Palette
preconditions: Extension installed; no .qemu-manager.json in workspace; libvirt/QEMU runtime reachable.

steps.expected_result: Extension activates without blocking VS Code startup.

steps.action: Open Command Palette and search for the command
steps.expected_result: Command `QEMU: Connect` is present and executable.

title: REQ-01: Activation on invoking any extension command before startup activation
preconditions: Extension installed but not yet activated; runtime reachable.

steps.action: Invoke an extension command before the extension has activated
steps.expected_result: Extension activates via the onCommand trigger and the command runs.

title: REQ-01: Activation when .qemu-manager.json exists in the workspace
preconditions: Extension installed and not activated; a file named `.qemu-manager.json` is placed in the workspace root.

steps.expected_result: Extension activates due to the file-presence trigger.

description: REQ-01 | positive | A-01 (deferred risk): the purpose/content of .qemu-manager.json is undefined. Case asserts only the literal activation trigger and does not assume any config role.

title: REQ-01: Cold activation within 1.5 s on reference hardware
preconditions: Cold start; reference hardware (4 cores, 8 GB RAM); extension installed.

steps.action: Measure time from VS Code start to extension activation
steps.expected_result: Cold activation completes within 1.5 s.

title: REQ-01: Cold activation at the 1.5 s boundary (just-inside / just-outside)
preconditions: Reference hardware (4 cores, 8 GB RAM); cold start; injection to simulate the timing values.

steps.expected_result: Considered within limit (≤ 1.5 s) — passes.
Exceeds the 1.5 s limit — boundary violation.

title: REQ-01: Activation error goes to degraded with notification and Retry (no silent fail)
preconditions: Extension installed; an activation failure is induced.

steps.action: Trigger activation with an induced error
steps.expected_result: Extension transitions to `degraded` state.
Notification «QEMU Manager: activation failed» is shown with a «Retry» action; activation does not fail silently.
Extension waits for an explicit re-launch.

description: REQ-01 | negative | A-07 (deferred risk): the exact 'explicit re-launch' trigger is undefined. Case asserts only the literal notification/action behavior.

steps.action: Add a connection with name `prod-1` and URI `qemu:///system`
steps.expected_result: Connection is accepted and added.

preconditions: VMs exist in each state: running, stopped, paused, suspended, crashed.

description: REQ-03 | boundary | A-02 (deferred risk): `suspended` has no producing/consuming requirement and no command assignment.
